prompt:
A sprite sheet of 3 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface of the plinth and the front face of the statue; the statue stands upright, base at the bottom). Arrange them in one row of 3, left to right, with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. Each prop is a small healing shrine: a serene robed goddess statue standing on a small ROUND stone plinth. She wears a long flowing robe and a hood/veil, head slightly bowed, and holds a small lantern in both hands in front of her chest. In front of the statue, part of the same round plinth, is a shallow round stone basin filled with clear, faintly luminous pale water. The statue stone is softly luminous in colour (pale moonlight-cream highlights on the robe folds and face), the little lantern glass is warm pale gold, and 5-7 tiny single-pixel pale-gold light motes float around her. The whole shrine fits a 2 x 2 map-tile footprint: the round plinth is about 56 art pixels wide, the statue with plinth about 84 art pixels tall. All three must be identical in pose, silhouette, size and layout; only the stone material and the small decorations change. The props, in order: 1) the goddess shrine carved in weathered blue-grey granite, with pale sea-salt stains and a little dark-green sea moss on the plinth (for a stone lighthouse); 2) the SAME shrine carved in pale old limestone, overgrown: soft green moss on the shoulders and plinth, a few thin tree roots and small ivy leaves wrapping around the plinth (for the inside of a giant ancient tree); 3) the SAME shrine carved in warm golden sandstone, worn smooth by sand, with a faded turquoise-and-gold inlaid band around the plinth and a sun motif (for an old desert royal tomb).
Scale: each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Exception: the lantern glass, the basin water, the light motes and the pale highlights of the statue may be softly luminous in colour, but no light spills or halos around them.
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Generate a NEW sprite sheet, NOT the assortment of dungeon props shown in the supplied reference. Exactly THREE fully separate small healing-shrine sprites, in a SINGLE HORIZONTAL ROW, evenly spaced with generous transparent gaps; no other objects. Transparent alpha background; no floor, shadows, lettering, borders or vignette. Each shrine is the SAME front-facing serene hooded/veiled robed goddess, head bowed, upright, holding one tiny warm-pale-gold glass lantern in BOTH hands at chest height, standing on a SMALL ROUND stone plinth. From classic JRPG 3/4 TOP-DOWN viewpoint see the elliptical top of the circular plinth as well as goddess's front; at the FRONT of each goddess, incorporated into the SAME plinth, one shallow circular stone basin full of clear faintly luminous pale water. Each entire sprite approximately 56 ART pixels across by 84 ART pixels high (including plinth), with identical pose, silhouette, proportion, lantern position, and basin position. 5–7 isolated SINGLE-ART-PIXEL pale-gold floating light motes around each goddess. Three variants from left to right: (1) weathered BLUE-GREY GRANITE goddess and plinth with pale sea-salt streaks and sparse dark-green sea moss ON THE PLINTH; (2) the identical shrine made of PALE AGED LIMESTONE, soft green moss on statue shoulders and round plinth, thin tree roots and a few little ivy leaves wrapping the plinth; (3) the identical shrine made of WARM GOLDEN SANDSTONE, smooth sand-worn edges, a faded turquoise-and-gold inlaid band around plinth with small sun motif. Their stone should have pale moonlight-cream highlight pixels on face and robe folds; lantern glass pale gold, basin water faint luminous pale aqua, WITHOUT ANY halo or cast light. Premium modern HD JRPG pixel art, hand-placed sharp square pixels all exactly same size, enlarged nearest-neighbor circa 6–8 output pixels per art pixel; clear chunky 3–10 art-pixel clusters, no anti-aliasing, gradients, blur, smudges, noise, photographic textures, or checkerboard dithering. Rich earthy 4–6-shade hue-shifted ramps per material, shadows slightly saturated purple-red and highlights warm yellow. Neutral soft even upper-left overcast lighting, clean unlit base colors, NO darkness, glow, environmental lighting or shadows. ALL THREE OBJECTS completely contained within frame with ample margin and non-touching.
